title: C2 Tamper / Anomaly Flag
description: Detector signal emitted by raw forensics Branch A (Guide §1.5, §3.4 C2). Advisory only.

code.description: Machine-readable indicator code (e.g. EDITING_TOOL_IN_METADATA, DUPLICATE_BLAKE3, ELA_ANOMALY)

severity.description: Risk tier of the indicator. Does not equate to legal guilt or fraud.

reason.description: Plain human-readable explanation of why the detector fired

artifact_uri.description: Relative URI to derived inspection artifact

value.description: Extracted string, number, or metadata value that triggered the flag

advisory.description: Flags are preliminary indicators requiring human verification; never automated accusations

simulated.description: Must be true if produced by a mock detector fixture
